rows.label: Quassus Prime relics
rows.note: buy extra Blade relics: every one carries it as the Rare

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
Vaulted relics and the parts themselves still trade between players.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

rows.label: Quassus Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Lith N18 or Lith T14 or Meso G8 or Meso L4 or Neo A15 or Neo V12 or Neo X1, Uncommon: 20% Radiant

rows.label: Quassus Prime Handle
rows.note: Axi G14 or Axi N13 or Axi T13 or Axi Y3 or Meso A8 or Meso V12 or Neo C8, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Quassus Prime Blade
rows.note: Lith Q1 or Lith Q2 or Lith Q3 or Neo Q1, Rare: 10% Radiant

conditions: Refine Blueprint and Blade relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Handle relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
